lines.t: When the thunder speaks, I listen deep within
Whisper truth, cause through my sin
I walk the line where light me shade
Following the path my maker laid
I bow, I yield, I hear your call Your will above my pride must fall
Teach me, Lord, to love and stay In the peace of your holy way
The world cries loud with empty sound But your quiet voice is where I'm found
Not my will, but yours be done The servant walks where walks the sun
I bow, I yield, I hear your call Your will above my pride must fall
Teach me, Lord, to love and stay In the peace of your holy way
The fire refines, the heart obeys When truth breaks chains, my soul is raised
From dusk to dawn, your word remains A crown of light through all my days
I bow, I yield, I hear your call Your will above, my pride must fall
Teach me, Lord, to love and stay In the peace of your holy way
Your voice, my guide, forever true Every step, I'll follow you
